 By Ticked Off PUBLISHED: November 13, 2026 at 8:00 AM EST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... • I’m leaving work and it’s already dark by 6 p.m. It’s depressing! “But if we have daylight saving time, kids will be going to school in the dark,” some say. DST is not the reason for that. The ridiculously early school start times is the reason why kids are going to school in the dark!
 • Hear that? The political ads are gone. We survived another barrage of campaigns on our televisions, radios, websites, emails, and mailboxes. Eighteen to 20 months of peace before the 2028 election clamor deafens us. Now all we have to do is mute the attorney and pharma ads.
 • If a coach or player is guaranteed an exorbitant multimillion-dollar contract no matter what their performance and behavior are, what incentive do they have to do a good job? They can be lazy and winless and still get all that money. Why aren’t there win-incentive contracts?
 • I am ticked at the eyeglasses commercial in which the clerk keeps cutting off the customer asking questions about his glasses. I know it’s supposed to be funny, but it comes off as rude. I wouldn’t want to buy glasses from someone who treated me like that.
 The flip side
 • Thank you, Orlando Sentinel, for putting Ronnie’s Restaurant on the front page of last Sunday’s edition. It brought back an avalanche of many fond memories. It was quirky with great food and awesome ice cream desserts. They are missed so very much.
 NEED TO VENT?: I’m Ticked Off! Are you? Write to tickedoff@orlandosentinel.com or flipside@orlandosentinel.com .
